rule.name: SpringUnreleasedResource
rule.message: Release this resource when the context closes: shut it down, close it or cancel it in a @PreDestroy method (shutdown, then shutdownNow when awaitTermination times out), DisposableBean.destroy, AutoCloseable.close or SmartLifecycle.stop, or declare it as its own @Bean or as a ThreadPoolTaskExecutor bean, which Spring closes. Spring closes only the beans it created, so this one keeps its threads or connections after the context closes, and non-daemon threads keep the JVM running.
